title: hardware-qml-audit: a null-circuit protocol for testing hardware quantum machine learning claims (code)
description: Code, notebooks, frozen pre-registration and results for a pre-registered test of projected quantum feature maps on 129 qubits of ibm_fez, and a five-step protocol (null circuit, batch identifiability, controlled job assignment, replay of submission orders, job-purged backtest) for testing hardware quantum machine learning claims on tabular data. The hardware outputs and data tables are in a companion data record.
